> as agent_ro, after 2000 ms: DELETE /druid/v2/sql/libredb-agent-cancel-own
  202 
  the statement answered about 0 s after the cancel: 500 (query id libredb-agent-cancel-own) {"error":"Unknown exception","errorClass":"java.lang.RuntimeException","host":null,"errorCode":"legacyQueryException","persona":"OPERATOR","category":"RUNTIME_FAILURE","errorMessage":"Sequence canceled","context":{"host":null,"errorClass":"java.lang.RuntimeException","legacyErrorCode":"Unknown exception"}}
